subject: ggplot histograms and setting conditions on the y-axis scale

messages.author: 7afc9426da77a5e3
messages.subject: ggplot histograms and setting conditions on the y-axis scale
parts:
Hi all,

I'm having trouble adjusting the scale of the y-axis to be specific to a subsample. I would like to display a histogram of data from four countries and have been able to do this. However, the scale on the y-axis is based on the count/sum(count) in the entire sample. How can I get the y-axis to only provide the count/sum(count) of each specific country?

This is what I have so far. 

ggplot(data, aes(Q3) ) +
  geom_histogram(aes( y = (..count..)/sum(..count..)))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  facet_grid(Country ~ ., scales="free_y")

messages.subject: Re: ggplot histograms and setting conditions on the y-axis scale
parts:
Thank you for your help. Just starting out with R. This is the code I figured out to make it work

ggplot(data, aes(Q3) ) +
  geom_histogram(aes( y = ..density.., group = Country)) +
